encode_text_with_sentencepiece: encode a string into SentencePiece subword tokens using the SentencepieceBPE encode method
decode_sentencepiece_tokens: decode SentencePiece subword tokens back into a readable string using the SentencepieceBPE decode method
check_beginning_of_word: check if a SentencePiece token is the beginning of a word using the is_beginning_of_word method
init_sentencepiece_bpe: initialize a SentencepieceBPE encoder by loading a SentencePiece model file via SentencepieceConfig
review_sentencepiece_config: review the SentencepieceConfig dataclass to understand the sentencepiece_model path field and default value
